keyPoints.en: Matter has mass and occupies space. It is made of atoms, molecules or ions.
keyPoints.bm: Jirim mempunyai jisim dan memenuhi ruang. Ia terdiri daripada atom, molekul atau ion.

keyPoints.en: Kinetic theory: particles are always moving. Evidence: diffusion and Brownian motion.
keyPoints.bm: Teori kinetik: zarah sentiasa bergerak. Bukti: resapan dan gerakan Brown.

keyPoints.en: Changes of state: melting, freezing, boiling/evaporation, condensation, sublimation (solid → gas) and deposition (gas → solid).
keyPoints.bm: Perubahan keadaan: lebur, beku, didih/penyejatan, kondensasi, pemejalwapan (pepejal → gas) dan pengenapan (gas → pepejal).

keyPoints.en: Heating curve: flat parts show melting/boiling — heat is absorbed to overcome forces between particles.
keyPoints.bm: Lengkung pemanasan: bahagian mendatar menunjukkan lebur/didih — haba diserap untuk mengatasi daya antara zarah.

keyPoints.en: Cooling curve: flat part at the freezing point — heat is released as particles form bonds.
keyPoints.bm: Lengkung penyejukan: bahagian mendatar pada takat beku — haba dibebaskan apabila zarah membentuk ikatan.

question.en: Why is naphthalene heated in a water bath, not directly?
question.bm: Mengapa naftalena dipanaskan dalam kukus air, bukan secara terus?

answer.en: For even heating, and because naphthalene is flammable.
answer.bm: Untuk pemanasan sekata, dan kerana naftalena mudah terbakar.

tip.en: During a change of state, temperature is constant but energy is still being absorbed or released.
tip.bm: Semasa perubahan keadaan, suhu malar tetapi tenaga masih diserap atau dibebaskan.

keyPoints.en: Dalton: atoms are tiny, indivisible spheres; atoms of one element are identical.
keyPoints.bm: Dalton: atom ialah sfera kecil yang tidak boleh dibahagi; atom unsur yang sama adalah serupa.

keyPoints.en: Thomson: discovered electrons; atom is a positive sphere with electrons embedded (plum pudding).
keyPoints.bm: Thomson: menemui elektron; atom ialah sfera positif dengan elektron terbenam (puding plum).

keyPoints.en: Rutherford: gold foil experiment → tiny dense positive nucleus; most of the atom is empty space.
keyPoints.bm: Rutherford: eksperimen kerajang emas → nukleus positif kecil dan tumpat; kebanyakan atom ruang kosong.

keyPoints.en: Bohr: electrons orbit the nucleus in fixed shells (energy levels).
keyPoints.bm: Bohr: elektron mengorbit nukleus dalam petala tetap (aras tenaga).

keyPoints.en: Chadwick: discovered neutrons in the nucleus — completing the modern model.
keyPoints.bm: Chadwick: menemui neutron dalam nukleus — melengkapkan model moden.

question.en: Which observation in Rutherford's experiment showed the nucleus is positive?
question.bm: Pemerhatian manakah dalam eksperimen Rutherford menunjukkan nukleus positif?

answer.en: Some positive alpha particles were deflected or bounced back (repelled).
answer.bm: Sebahagian zarah alfa positif dipesongkan atau melantun balik (ditolak).

tip.en: Remember the order with 'Doktor Tua Rajin Baca Cerita' (Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr, Chadwick).
tip.bm: Ingat urutan dengan 'Doktor Tua Rajin Baca Cerita' (Dalton, Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr, Chadwick).

keyPoints.en: Proton: charge +1, mass 1. Neutron: charge 0, mass 1. Electron: charge −1, mass ≈ 1/1840.
keyPoints.bm: Proton: cas +1, jisim 1. Neutron: cas 0, jisim 1. Elektron: cas −1, jisim ≈ 1/1840.

keyPoints.en: Proton number Z = number of protons. Nucleon number A = protons + neutrons.
keyPoints.bm: Nombor proton Z = bilangan proton. Nombor nukleon A = proton + neutron.

keyPoints.en: In a neutral atom, number of electrons = number of protons.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam atom neutral, bilangan elektron = bilangan proton.

keyPoints.en: Electron arrangement fills shells 2, 8, 8 … e.g. Ca (20) = 2.8.8.2.
keyPoints.bm: Susunan elektron mengisi petala 2, 8, 8 … cth. Ca (20) = 2.8.8.2.

keyPoints.en: Valence electrons (outer shell) decide how an atom reacts.
keyPoints.bm: Elektron valens (petala luar) menentukan cara atom bertindak balas.

question.en: ²⁷₁₃Al: give the number of protons, neutrons and electrons.
question.bm: ²⁷₁₃Al: berikan bilangan proton, neutron dan elektron.

tip.en: The bigger number in the symbol is always the nucleon number.
tip.bm: Nombor yang lebih besar dalam simbol sentiasa nombor nukleon.

keyPoints.en: Isotopes: atoms of the same element with the same proton number but different nucleon numbers.
keyPoints.bm: Isotop: atom unsur yang sama dengan nombor proton sama tetapi nombor nukleon berbeza.

keyPoints.en: Isotopes have the same chemical properties but different physical properties (mass, density).
keyPoints.bm: Isotop mempunyai sifat kimia yang sama tetapi sifat fizik berbeza (jisim, ketumpatan).

keyPoints.en: Examples: hydrogen (¹H, ²H, ³H), carbon (¹²C, ¹³C, ¹⁴C), chlorine (³⁵Cl, ³⁷Cl).
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: hidrogen (¹H, ²H, ³H), karbon (¹²C, ¹³C, ¹⁴C), klorin (³⁵Cl, ³⁷Cl).

keyPoints.en: Uses: C-14 (dating artefacts), Co-60 (cancer treatment, sterilising), I-131 (thyroid), Na-24 (pipe leaks), P-32 (plant studies), U-235 (nuclear power).
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan: C-14 (usia artifak), Co-60 (rawatan kanser, pensterilan), I-131 (tiroid), Na-24 (kebocoran paip), P-32 (kajian tumbuhan), U-235 (tenaga nuklear).

question.en: Why do ³⁵Cl and ³⁷Cl react the same way with sodium?
question.bm: Mengapa ³⁵Cl dan ³⁷Cl bertindak balas sama dengan natrium?

answer.en: They have the same electron arrangement (2.8.7), so the same chemical properties.
answer.bm: Kedua-duanya mempunyai susunan elektron sama (2.8.7), jadi sifat kimia sama.

tip.en: Radioisotopes are useful but must be handled with shielding (lead) and kept far away.
tip.bm: Radioisotop berguna tetapi mesti dikendalikan dengan perisai (plumbum) dan dijauhkan.
